isolation:
SECURITY HARDENING (priority, do this before any webhook work or republish). Context: our explorers (symmetryengine.space, fractalchaos.space, plicolab.space, interactivemaths.space, interactiveart.space) share ONE Stripe account and the same STRIPE_SECRET_KEY. Stripe sends every webhook endpoint in the account every subscribed event, and any paid Checkout session id from any explorer is a valid session in that account. Nothing paid on another explorer may ever unlock VIP here. Implement and test all of the following:

1) One source of truth for "this explorer's purchase": a server-side check isOwnPurchase(session) that retrieves the Checkout Session from Stripe by id (expand line_items; never trust the webhook body or URL alone) and requires ALL of: mode = payment, status = complete, payment_status = paid, exactly one line item whose price.id equals this explorer's own VIP price id (resolved server-side from its lookup key / config, not from the client), amount_total and currency equal that price, livemode = true in production, and metadata.explorer = this explorer's domain. Set metadata.explorer (on the session AND payment_intent_data.metadata) when creating Checkout from now on.

2) Use isOwnPurchase everywhere access is granted: /vip/success session verification, the webhook (checkout.session.completed), any "restore purchase" path and the hourly re-check. Anything that fails it: ignore and return 200 to Stripe for webhooks (so Stripe does not retry), grant nothing, log one line without secrets or personal data.

3) Refunds and disputes (charge.refunded, charge.dispute.created): act only if the payment_intent maps to a purchase row this explorer already stored; otherwise ignore. Revoke on full refund or dispute.

4) Cookie isolation: the cookie signing key must be HMAC-SHA256(STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, "vip-cookie-v2:" + this explorer's domain), so a cookie minted by another explorer can never verify here. The cookie payload must contain the domain (audience), the purchase id and an expiry, be httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, scoped to this domain only (no parent-domain cookie). Verify all fields on every premium request, and that the purchase row is still entitled. Rotate: old-format cookies are rejected (owner accepts that existing VIPs re-verify once).

5) One session, one owner: a Checkout session id can be claimed once. Store the claim; a second claim from a different browser must not mint a new cookie (show "restore via the email you paid with" instead, and implement restore as: email a one-time link, or match the Stripe customer email on a fresh Checkout-verified session; never just "type an email"). Rate-limit /vip/success, restore and checkout endpoints per IP.

6) Webhook endpoint hygiene: verify the Stripe-Signature with THIS explorer's own stored secret using the raw body and a 5-minute tolerance; reject otherwise with 400. Record processed event ids and ignore replays. Enabled events only: checkout.session.completed, charge.refunded, charge.dispute.created. Self-provisioning on production startup as briefed (exact url https://<this domain>/api/stripe/webhook, metadata explorer=<this domain>, advisory lock, never log the secret, never create a second endpoint for the same url, never delete/archive anything in Stripe).

7) No leaks: premium data only from server endpoints that check the cookie (401 otherwise); no premium content or price ids bundled in client JS beyond what the teaser shows; no Stripe ids, emails or secrets in logs, responses or errors; CORS only for this domain.

8) Tests (automated, with mocked Stripe objects, must pass before you say ready): (a) a paid session for a DIFFERENT price/explorer at /vip/success grants nothing; (b) the same via webhook is ignored with 200; (c) a cookie signed with another explorer's derived key is rejected (401); (d) a tampered or expired cookie is rejected; (e) a replayed webhook event id is ignored; (f) a refund for an unknown payment_intent changes nothing; (g) a refund for our own purchase revokes access; (h) bad signature returns 400; (i) a second claim of a used session id from a new browser mints no cookie; (j) a correct own purchase unlocks VIP.

Report: files changed, test output summary, any migration SQL (must be additive only), and say "ready to republish". Do not republish yourself. Stay in Free mode. Never ask for or print secrets.
